eligibility.condition: Above legal age of majority in country of residence

challenge.title: DataNova 2026 – Global Data-thon
challenge.slogan: Turning Data Into Decisions. Building Solutions That Matter.
challenge.description:
DataNova 2026 – Global Data-thon is an international, virtual innovation challenge that brings together students, researchers, and working professionals to solve real-world problems through Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data-driven innovation.
Participants are invited to transform ideas into practical, impactful solutions that address challenges across industries and society. Whether you're building predictive models, developing intelligent applications, uncovering insights from complex datasets, or designing data-driven strategies, DataNova is an opportunity to demonstrate your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving abilities.
challenge.what_we_are_looking_for:
We encourage solutions that demonstrate a clear problem statement, sound technical methodology, originality, practical feasibility, responsible technology use, and measurable potential impact.
Projects will be assessed against the competition's published judging criteria. Participants should clearly communicate their approach, implementation, validation, and the value their solution creates.
DataNova 2026 is more than a competition—a platform to experiment, collaborate, and demonstrate how data can drive meaningful change.
challenge.closing_statement: Bring your ideas. Build your solution. Turn data into decisions.

step.title: Register for the challenge
step.description: Complete your registration through the official competition listing on Devpost and review the eligibility requirements, rules, and deadlines.

step.title: Choose a problem and track
step.description: Identify a real-world problem aligned with one of the challenge tracks. Define the problem clearly, identify your target users, and explain why your proposed solution matters.

step.title: Build your solution
step.description: Develop your project using appropriate technologies, datasets, analytical methods, or AI/ML techniques. Focus on originality, technical quality, feasibility, and responsible use of data.

step.title: Prepare your submission
step.description: Create a complete project submission that includes the project title and overview, problem statement, solution and methodology, demonstration, impact and validation, and team contributions.

step.title: Submit before the deadline
step.description: Review the official Devpost challenge page for the final submission deadline, required deliverables, and applicable rules. Ensure all links and supporting materials work before submitting.

step.title: Present your work
step.description: Shortlisted participants may be invited to present or demonstrate their projects during the evaluation or final round, subject to the official competition schedule.

component.name: Problem statement
component.description: Describe the challenge you are addressing.

component.name: Solution and methodology
component.description: Explain your approach, technologies, and implementation.

component.name: Demonstration
component.description: Include a working prototype, demo video, screenshots, or other supporting material, as applicable.

component.name: Impact and validation
component.description: Explain how the solution works, how you tested it, and its potential real-world value.

component.name: Team contributions
component.description: Clearly identify team members and their respective contributions.

tips_for_a_strong_submission.tip: Solve a clearly defined and meaningful problem.
Demonstrate your own work and explain your technical decisions.
Use reliable evidence to support your results and claims.
Follow data privacy, security, licensing, and responsible AI practices.
Make your project easy for judges to understand and evaluate.

hackathon.closing_message: We look forward to seeing your ideas and the solutions you build.

what_to_build.instruction: Visit website (https://datanovathon.com/). Explore tracks from the menu and select the track you want to create the project in. Open the problem statement and then create the working models as a solution.

criterion.name: Innovation & Originality
criterion.description: Novelty of the idea, creativity, and differentiation from existing solutions.

criterion.name: Technical Implementation
criterion.description: Technical complexity, quality of execution, appropriate use of tools, and functionality.

criterion.name: Problem Relevance
criterion.description: Clarity of the problem statement, importance, and alignment with the selected track.

criterion.name: Data & Analytical Rigor
criterion.description: Quality of data usage, analytical methodology, model validation, and reliability of results.

criterion.name: Impact & Feasibility
criterion.description: Practical applicability, scalability, and potential real-world or societal impact.

criterion.name: Presentation & Documentation
criterion.description: Clarity of explanation, demonstration quality, and completeness of supporting documentation.

problem_statements.description: Explore the problem statements. Find a challenge that matches your skills—and build a solution that makes a difference.

problem.title: Multilingual Intelligent Document Understanding
problem.description: Build an AI system that extracts, classifies and structures information from multilingual business documents (invoices, contracts, forms) with varying layouts and quality.

problem.title: Customer Churn Prediction and Retention Strategy
problem.description: Predict customer churn and recommend targeted retention actions based on behavior and engagement data.

problem.title: Network Intrusion Detection with Imbalanced Threat Data
problem.description: Develop a network intrusion detection model that handles highly imbalanced threat data and adapts to evolving attack patterns.
problem.suggested_technologies: Python, deep learning, SMOTE, ensemble methods

problem.title: Urban Mobility Pattern Analysis from Transit Data
problem.description: Analyze public transit data to uncover mobility patterns, identify underserved routes and propose data-driven service improvements.
problem.suggested_technologies: Python, Pandas, GeoPandas, Tableau / Power BI

problem.title: Adaptive Learning Path Recommendation
problem.description: Design a recommendation engine that personalizes learning paths for students based on performance, behavior and goals.

problem.title: Real-Time Payment Fraud Detection
problem.description: Build a real-time anomaly detection system that flags fraudulent payment transactions with low false-positive rates.
problem.suggested_technologies: Python, streaming frameworks, isolation forest, gradient boosting

problem.title: Early Risk Stratification for Chronic Disease
problem.description: Develop a predictive model that stratifies patients by risk of developing a chronic condition using electronic health records.

problem.title: Open Innovation Challenge
problem.description: Bring your own real-world problem and demonstrate a data-driven solution with measurable impact.
problem.suggested_technologies: Open — choose the stack that fits your problem.

problem.title: Last-Mile Delivery Route Optimization
problem.description: Optimize last-mile delivery routes under capacity, time-window and traffic constraints to reduce cost and improve service.

problem.title: Food Bank Resource Allocation Optimization
problem.description: Optimize the allocation of food donations across distribution centers to minimize waste and meet community need.

problem.title: Solar Energy Generation Forecasting
problem.description: Forecast solar energy generation from weather and plant data to support grid stability and renewable planning.
